description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface, which declares asynchronous methods for fetching catalog items, brands, and types in the web application.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a paginated list of catalog items filtered by brand and type.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available brands as select list items.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available product types as select list items.
